title: Diarrhea & Loose Motions (Atisara) — Dual-System Clinical Monograph
source: WHO Diarrheal Disease Protocols & AYUSH API
content:
Condition: Acute Diarrhea, Gastroenteritis & Loose Motions (Atisara).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Oral Rehydration Salts (WHO-ORS) packet in 1 Liter clean water (Primary lifesaving rehydration therapy). Zinc Supplementation 20mg daily for 14 days. Loperamide 2mg (only in non-infectious watery diarrhea; avoid in dysentery/fever). Probiotics (Lactobacillus / Saccharomyces boulardii).
Ayurvedic Formulations: Kutajarishta (15-20ml with equal water post meals - Holarrhena antidysenterica). Bilwadi Churna (3g with buttermilk). Mustakarishta.
Home Remedies: Pomegranate peel decoction, Rice gruel water (Kanji) with pinch of salt, Arrowroot porridge, Banana and curd diet.
Red Flags: Stool containing blood/mucus, severe dehydration (sunken eyes, no urine), or high fever requires clinical evaluation.
